control.description-key: Read-only progress bar for any number column, with optional label and colour thresholds.

property.name: value
property.description-key: The number to show progress for.

property.name: maxValue
property.description-key: The value that counts as 100%. Default 100.

property.name: barColor
property.description-key: CSS colour for the bar. Default #0f6cbd.

property.name: completeColor
property.description-key: Optional CSS colour used once the value reaches the maximum.

property.name: showLabel
property.description-key: Show the percentage next to the bar.
